_comment: Claude Code hook registration for sage-mode. Mirrors hooks.json (the
Cursor registration) but with Claude Code's own event names and
config nesting: {"hooks":{"EventName":[{"matcher":...,"hooks":[{...}]}]}}
— note the extra nested "hooks" array per matcher entry, which
hooks.json (Cursor) does not have.
Every script here is the SAME file hooks.json points at (hooks/ is
shared) — each one detects which host invoked it at runtime via
host-detect.sh's sage_detect_host and shapes its JSON response
accordingly (json-safe.sh's emit_deny/emit_ask/emit_allow/
emit_followup). Nothing here is a separate Claude-only script.
Events used: ONLY PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SessionStart, Stop, and
SubagentStop are registered below — all five are HIGH confidence per
this plugin's research pass. SubagentStart is deliberately NOT used
anywhere in this file: its existence in Claude Code is LOW confidence
(unverified). Consequently sage-lane's subagent-depth guard
(hooks/sage-solo — 'a reviewer cannot spawn child subagents') has NO
Claude Code registration here at all, and that guarantee is UNENFORCED
on Claude Code by any hook; it must instead be carried as a plain
instruction on the reviewer/red-team/design-critic agent cards. See
hooks/README.md's 'Claude Code gaps' section for this and the other
gaps (sage-bootstrap env-var injection, rules/sage-conduct.mdc).
SubagentStop is intentionally left unregistered below: no sage-mode
hook currently has a real use for it (nothing here needs to react to a
subagent finishing). Add an entry here if/when one does.
PreToolUse deny: emit_deny emits BOTH the modern hookSpecificOutput
shape AND the legacy top-level decision/reason shape in the same JSON
object, and exits 2 — see the block comment above emit_deny in
json-safe.sh for why (one unverified source claims Claude Code no
longer parses the legacy shape; not trusted enough to bet a security
hook on, so both are emitted as belt, braces, and a third backstop).
timeout units are assumed to be seconds, mirroring hooks.json's
Cursor values (5s for the fast checks, 20s for sage-proof's evidence
check) — this was not independently confirmed against Claude Code's
own docs in this pass; flagging the assumption rather than silently
carrying it.
